questions: How long have you had this headache?
Is the pain throbbing, dull, or sharp, and is it on one side or both sides of your head?
Do you have other symptoms like fever, nausea, or changes in vision?
redFlags: Headache accompanied by stiff neck, high fever, or confusion
Headache with numbness, weakness, difficulty speaking, or difficulty walking
recommendations: Ensure you are well-hydrated, rest in a quiet, dark room, and avoid screen time. If symptoms persist or worsen, consult a healthcare provider.
source: AIIMS New Delhi Patient Education Portal & Mayo Clinic
